title: audit detail session.model_switched
description: detail of audit rows with action session.model_switched: the runner moved a session to another model access because its access was used up, could not be used or was released again (ADR-081 sections 4 and 5): the access kinds and models before and after, the cause and the release time of the used-up access (null without one). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
